import csv
rows=list(csv.reader(open('table.csv')))
hdr=rows[0]; data=rows[1:]
n=len(hdr)
def is_num(col):
    for r in data:
        try: float(r[col])
        except: return False
    return True
num=[is_num(i) for i in range(n)]
def esc(s): return s.replace('|','\\|')
w=[3]*n
for i in range(n):
    cells=[esc(hdr[i])]+[esc(r[i]) for r in data]
    w[i]=max(len(c) for c in cells)
out=[]
def line(cells):
    parts=[cells[i].rjust(w[i]) if num[i] else cells[i].ljust(w[i]) for i in range(n)]
    return '| '+' | '.join(parts)+' |'
out.append(line([esc(h) for h in hdr]))
sep=[]
for i in range(n):
    sep.append(('-'*(w[i]-1)+':') if num[i] else '-'*w[i])
out.append('| '+' | '.join(sep)+' |')
for r in data:
    out.append(line([esc(c) for c in r]))
text='\n'.join(out)+'\n'
open('table.md','w').write(text)
print(repr(text))
